text:
Alex P.: Heads up — on-call just flagged a backfill that's eating tokens but not progressing for tenant T-42. Ops sees steady reads but no new aggregates. 
Maria L.: ugh. Which job? ID?
Alex P.: job 2026-03-t42-agg-recompute. It's in state RUNNING for 3h, processed 0.3M keys, last emitted metric at 2h ago.
Samir: putting on my detective hat. Can you paste the operator logs? low-churn mode might be stuck waiting on shard claim.
Jen (ops): copied logs here: ```
[2026-03-18T09:12:33Z] START shard=17
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] claim_attempts=3
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] rate_limit_applied=true
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] waiting_for_quota_token
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] last_progress=0
```
Kevin: looks like the new quota shim is returning SoftBackpressure for that tenant; the console routing policy then keeps it RUNNING (to avoid queue churn) instead of failing fast.
nora: that's by design but ops needs visibility. Right now the console shows only job state and percent tokens billed — no circuit for "waiting_for_quota_token" or "shard_claim_retries".
Maria L.: can we add a per-job metric: `job_blocker_reason` and `job_blocker_since`? even a simple label would help ops triage.
Samir: +1. Also add a histogram for `shard_claim_latency_ms`. That would make it clear if specific shards are flapping.
Alex P.: UI ask: console-team, can we surface a Read-only "backfill health" panel with these three items: blocker reason, progress ETA, and recent error snippets? Ops wants an ETA estimation to decide escalate vs wait.
console-team: we discussed ETA before — accurate ETAs are hard because of dynamic throttling. We can provide a conservative range: optimistic/p99, safe/p50, and a confidence flag. Would that work? :thinking:
Jen (ops): yes, even a conservative estimate is better than blind guessing. Add a button to "escalate to preempt" which will move it to preemptible lane (operator-only).
Kevin: caution: preemptible lane bypasses some tenant isolation checks — need an audit log and tenant-owner approval flow.
Maria L.: fine — audit log event + brief reason text required. Could be an inline modal: `confirm transfer: reason (text)`.
Samir: technical note — exposing `job_blocker_reason` means runtime must bubble up the quota/backpressure code path. I can add a lightweight tag in the workloop, should be ~2hrs dev.
Alex P.: what's the UX effort? console-team?
console-team: prototyping a panel takes ~1 day, shipping with metrics wired is ~2 sprints unless we do a minimal version that reads new job labels and shows them in the existing job detail drawer. Minimal version: 2-3 days.
Jen (ops): minimal version please. Also add an alert rule: when job is RUNNING and `job_blocker_since > 10m`, ping `#eng-platform oncall` and add a PagerDuty event.
Kevin: agree. But that alert will fire during normal slowdowns, add a severity multiplier for tenant priority.
Maria L.: we should also avoid double-counting cost in billing dashboards if we expose `tokens_billed` + `tokens_retried`. Ops: what's the current billing metric?
Jen (ops): `tokens_emitted_total` is used for billing. Backfills currently increment `tokens_emitted_total` even while stalled because of periodic heartbeat. We need a separate `tokens_effective_processed`.
Samir: will add `tokens_effective_processed` and a flag `heartbeat_only=true` on the heartbeat metric so billing pipeline can exclude it.
Alex P.: decision checklist: (1) Samir adds `job_blocker_reason` + `shard_claim_latency_ms` + `tokens_effective_processed` (ETA ~2-4hrs) (2) console-team ships minimal job-detail panel to read those labels (ETA ~3 days) (3) Jen adds alert rule + PD integration (ETA today) (4) Kevin and security to spec preemptible audit modal (action)
Maria L.: also add a UI opt-in in the backfill API `?aggressive=true` for SREs to request more parallelism for specific jobs, with rate-limits applied. That helps for urgent rescues.
Kevin: API change ok but must be gated by tenant owner scope and rate-limited globally. Add `X-Aggr-Override` header for operator calls.
Alex P.: Samir, can you add a small console of how to call it?
Samir: example: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/backfills/2026-03-t42-agg-recompute/run?aggressive=true" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Aggr-Override: ops:2026-03-18"
```
Jen (ops): I'll test once Samir lands the labels. Meanwhile I've muted noisy alerts but will keep app-level wakeups.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: samir/recompute-metrics -> staging. CI: 2/3 passed.
Alex P.: thanks everyone. Follow-up: Samir, ping this thread when labels are in and console-team when panel prototype is up.
Maria L.: tagging in docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/backfills/operator-runbook (please add a short section about the new metrics) :memo:
